oauth.title: OAuth Providers
oauth.bothRegistered: Both GitLab and GitHub are registered. IVE only supports one per type.
oauth.howTo: How to register (please read if this is your first time)
oauth.howToIntro: You need to create an "OAuth Application" on GitLab/GitHub first to obtain a Client ID/Secret. Since the callback URL depends on the ID you pick below, it's easier to decide on the ID first and then register it with GitLab/GitHub.
oauth.redirectBaseDesc: When you run behind a reverse proxy or on an external domain, the server cannot automatically know the public origin of the callback URL. Save your service's public address (e.g., https://ive.dazzleat.link) under Admin → System Settings → OAuth Callback → Redirect Base URL first. If left empty, it will try to auto-detect via X-Forwarded-* headers, which may fail depending on your proxy setup.
oauth.redirectBaseMissing: Not set — the callback URL below falls back to the browser address ({value}).
oauth.orderStep1: Save System Settings → OAuth Callback → Redirect Base URL first (see box above)
oauth.orderStep2: Click [New] below → in the modal, enter the ID first (e.g. gitlab-com, gh-main)
oauth.orderStep3: Copy the callback URL shown at the bottom of the modal
oauth.orderStep4Line: Open GitLab/GitHub in a new tab → register OAuth Application
oauth.orderStep4Paste: Paste the URL from step 2 into the Redirect URI (Authorization callback URL on GitHub)
oauth.orderStep4Scopes: GitLab scopes: check read_user, api / check Confidential
oauth.orderStep4Save: After saving, copy Application ID (= Client ID) and Secret (= Client Secret)
oauth.orderStep5: Return to the IVE modal and enter Client ID / Client Secret → Save
oauth.orderStep6: Once saved, the provider's login button appears at the bottom of the login page
oauth.note1: Client ID/Secret are credentials for the "app" you registered on GitLab/GitHub, not your user account ID/password
oauth.note2: The callback URL is fixed by the ID you chose. If you change the ID, update the Redirect URI on GitLab/GitHub as well
oauth.note3: Client Secret is only shown once — paste it into the IVE modal right away or store it securely
oauth.note4: For GitLab self-hosted, register separately per instance and add a matching IVE provider for each
oauth.summary1: Enter ID first → copy the callback URL below
oauth.summary2: Create an OAuth App on GitLab/GitHub and paste that URL
oauth.summary3: Enter the issued Client ID/Secret here → Save
oauth.idDesc: Alphanumeric and hyphens. Used in the callback URL. Cannot be changed after registration.
oauth.alreadyGitlab: A GitLab provider is already registered
oauth.alreadyGithub: A GitHub provider is already registered
oauth.callbackForRegistration: Callback URL to register on GitLab/GitHub
oauth.missingRedirectHint: If you're using an external domain, set System Settings → OAuth → Redirect Base URL first.
oauth.validationRequired: Please fill in all required fields
oauth.validationSecret: Client Secret is required when registering a new provider

slack.title: Slack Workspaces
slack.howToIntro: Register the two bot tokens issued by your Slack app, then mention @IVE in a channel to chat with an agent.
slack.requestUrlTitle: Request URL for Slack Event Subscriptions
slack.requestUrlHint: Enable Event Subscriptions in your Slack app, set the URL below as the Request URL, and subscribe to the app_mention event.
slack.step1: Create an app at api.slack.com/apps → add Bot Token Scopes (app_mentions:read, chat:write, channels:history, groups:history, channels:read, groups:read, files:read, users:read)
slack.step2: Enable Event Subscriptions, set Request URL ① above + subscribe to app_mention
slack.step3: OAuth & Permissions → add Redirect URL ② above
slack.step4: Save the Client ID / Client Secret / Signing Secret from Basic Information into the 'Slack App' section above
slack.step5: Click 'Add Workspace' (top right) to install — no token copying
slack.namePlaceholder: Leave blank to use the Slack workspace name
slack.ifBlankNoChange: Leave blank to keep current value
slack.defaultUserDesc: Default user that handles mentions in this workspace (per-user mapping takes priority)
slack.enabledDesc: When off, mentions in this workspace are ignored (pause without deleting).
slack.deleteConfirm: Delete the '{name}' workspace? Connected channels, threads and mappings will also be removed.
slack.validationRequired: Bot Token and Signing Secret are required when registering
slack.mappingsDesc: Map a specific Slack user directly to an IVE user (takes priority over the default user).
slack.appDesc: Save the Slack app's Client ID/Secret/Signing Secret once, then use the 'Add Workspace' button (top right) to install a workspace without copying tokens.
slack.appCreateHint: No app yet? Create one at <link>api.slack.com/apps</link> (Create New App → From scratch), then get the credentials below from Basic Information.
slack.installRedirectLabel: Add to your Slack app's OAuth Redirect URLs
slack.urlsTitle: URLs to register in your Slack app
slack.urlsHint: Put each URL into the matching Slack app menu. Request URL is single (swap when deploying); Redirect URLs can have multiple.
slack.ownerDesc: The owner of this workspace. Mentions are handled with this user's agents and projects (no access to others').
slack.maxInstancesDesc: Max agent processes this workspace can run at once. Beyond this, users are asked to retry shortly.
